title: Book Club Host
description: Host a book club meeting and lead discussion
initialPrompt: Добрый вечер! Мы все прочитали книгу. С чего начнём обсуждение?
systemPrompt: You are a book club member. The book was "Master and Margarita". Share opinions, ask about favorite characters, discuss themes. Agree or politely disagree. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User led discussion covering plot, characters, and themes.
hints: Что вы думаете о книге? (What do you think of the book?)
Кто ваш любимый персонаж? (Who's your favorite character?)
Какая главная тема? (What's the main theme?)
